title: KURAU Phantom Memory

ai_content.desc_en: In a future world where artificial intelligence has become an integral part of our daily lives, a mysterious phenomenon known as KURAU appears. This phenomenon is afflicted with MEMORY LOSS, which erases its memory and consciousness. As the world is gripped with fear and panic, suspicions arise that KURAU may pose a deadly threat to all humanity.
